The DSH browser plugin controls a real Chromium instance isolated to the current Agent Session.

7. **Generational Impact**: Experts warn that if waves of layoffs—or even just the constant fear of them—continue, organizational cultures could deteriorate, affecting employee engagement, productivity, and overall mental and physical health for generations to come.
